title: Velvety Peruvian Chicken Legs Chupe De Camarones
description: A yeasty, pillowy, lazy-sunday Peruvian dish featuring chicken legs, yuzu-cure, in a Jain-friendly form of chupe-de-camarones, served in a bento-box. This dish is a unique blend of Peruvian and Japanese flavors.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together yuzu juice, yeast, and 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil to create the yuzu-cure.
Add the chicken legs to the bowl and marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Heat the remaining vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Remove the chicken from the marinade and cook in the skillet until browned on all sides.
Add the chopped onion and minced garlic to the skillet and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add the chopped peruvian aji amarillo peppers to the skillet and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Season the chicken and vegetables with sea salt to taste.
Serve the chicken and vegetables in a bento-box, garnished with additional yuzu juice and peruvian aji amarillo peppers if desired.
Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F before serving.
